# Perseverance AI

> Fixing broken documentation before users complain.

Perseverance AI helps engineering teams maintain high-quality documentation by automatically detecting and fixing issues like broken code examples, outdated APIs, and content gaps.

## Key Features

- **GitHub Issues Sync**: Turn GitHub Issues into documentation fixes automatically. Connect your repo, filter for docs-related issues, and generate specific code changes.
- **Doc Health Check**: Analyze any documentation URL for relevance, freshness, clarity, accuracy, and completeness.
- **Console**: A dedicated dashboard to manage your documentation health and sync settings.
